Spell Sounds Starter Pack
=========================

Author : p0ss  (OpenGameArt.org user)
Source : https://opengameart.org/content/spell-sounds-starter-pack
Date   : 2011-03-03
License: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported (CC-BY-SA 3.0)
         (the pack also carries GPL 3.0 / GPL 2.0 options)
License URI: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/

Attribution (required)
----------------------
Spell sound effects by p0ss, via OpenGameArt.org,
licensed under CC-BY-SA 3.0 — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/

What this project uses
----------------------
22 sound effects were taken from this pack, trimmed, fade-in/out, peak-normalized
and re-encoded to mono AAC (.m4a). They are derivative works and are distributed
under CC-BY-SA 3.0 as well. The exact source-file mapping is listed in
CREDITS.md §3.1:

  swing, cleave, volley, dash, fire, inferno, meteor, boom, freeze, storm, wall,
  cast, blink, shoot, boon, pickup, box, curse, confusion, dead, horn, cheer
  (public/assets/sfx/*.m4a)

Scope
-----
The ShareAlike obligation applies to these audio files (and to modifications of
them). It does not extend to the rest of the game, which is a separate collective
work: game code, models, other audio and art remain under their own licenses.

Note
----
Files inside the original zip are RIFF/WAVE data despite the .ogg extension; this
project converts them rather than redistributing the originals.
